correctness.rationale: The exact four edge sine equations reduce to the one parameter s in [2a/K-1,1]. Exhausting all two-valued inverse-sine branches gives exactly two isolated equilibria and one connected circle for K>a, a unique point for K=a and none otherwise. The Laplacian characteristic polynomial is identically z^2[z^2-4(x^2+y^2)], yielding quotient spectra, and the concave quadratic has the exact claimed extrema. Local coordinates through each endpoint establish smoothness. A deterministic symbolic determinant computation and direct phase-balance tests passed.
